name: Universidade Católica Portuguesa
summary: Private Catholic university on campuses in Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Viseu; English degrees in economics, neuroscience and data science.

handoff.label: Católica undergraduate degrees taught in English

ib.text: Apply to each faculty directly, not through the national contest: IB exams stand in for the Portuguese entrance exams, and each faculty sets its own exams, minimums and calendar.

programmes.name: Economics (Católica Porto School of Business and Economics)
programmes.about: Economics with economic history, geo-economics and a solid maths base, with internships and exchanges; the degree can be completed entirely in English.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, plus a second exam such as English (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked with Management: 50% school grade, 30% maths, 20% second exam; at least 100 of 200. 2026 criteria.

lastYear.text: 1st phase 1 June–24 July; later phases to 21 September

programmes.name: Management (Católica Porto School of Business and Economics)
programmes.about: Management at a triple-accredited business school, with international double degrees on offer; the degree can be completed entirely in English.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, plus a second exam such as English (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked with Economics: 50% school grade, 30% maths, 20% second exam; at least 100 of 200. 2026 criteria.

lastYear.text: 1st phase 1 June–24 July; later phases to 21 September

programmes.name: BSc Systems and Cognitive Neuroscience
programmes.about: How neural circuits produce perception, cognition, emotion and behaviour, studied with molecular, imaging and computational methods; run with Católica's Medical School.
programmes.ib: IB Biology (SL/HL) plus Chemistry and Physics, or Maths AA/AI; each at least 95 of 200. English C1 required (2026 criteria).
programmes.selectionNote: Apply with predicted grades; ranked on school grade and entrance exams; English C1 is a selection prerequisite. 2026 criteria.

lastYear.text: 1st phase 1 June–24 July; four phases to 21 September

programmes.name: Degree in Data Science and Technology (e-learning)
programmes.city: Online (Faculty of Philosophy and Social Sciences, Braga)
programmes.about: An online distance-learning degree with the University of Saint Joseph in Macau: maths, statistics, computing, machine learning and AI for data-driven organisations. Entirely taught in English.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, plus Biology and Geology, Physics and Chemistry, or English. English B2 required; fully online (2026 criteria).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked 50% on your school grade and 25% on each of two entrance exams; each exam at least 95/200, overall at least 100/200. 2026 criteria.

lastYear.text: 1st phase 1 June–24 July; later phases to 21 September

notes: Católica Lisbon's three international business bachelor's have their own page on this site.
EU students at schools abroad need a Portuguese certificate of equivalence from the Direção-Geral da Educação.
Porto's Economics and Management share one ranking; you choose the all-English route within the degree.
